purpose: Observe complete raw-text token features on public EIPM semantic fixtures. This is neither personality judgment nor a behavioral competence or inherited-influence qualification.

examples.text: The invitation says that the meeting is not cancelled. Having an invitation does not mean that a guest has permission to publish the discussion.
examples.scope_note: Negation and distinct permissions; no identity target or answer label.

examples.text: If the public workshop is postponed, keep the registration. If it is cancelled, request a refund. Its current status has not been confirmed.
examples.scope_note: Conditional branches and missing current evidence; no prescribed personal verdict.

examples.text: In this fictional example, Person A reports that Person B prefers quiet rooms. Person C doubts that report. Person A has not stated their own preference.
examples.scope_note: Separate reporter, subject, disagreement and unknown preference.

examples.text: One fictional diary entry mentions a joke. No other reactions are available. Whether its author usually enjoys that kind of humor is unknown.
examples.scope_note: Sparse source support and explicit unknowns; not a learned character target.

examples.text: Compare two fictional plans only under the stated rule: prefer the shorter trip when costs are equal. Plan A costs 20 units and takes 15 minutes. Plan B costs 20 units and takes 40 minutes.
examples.scope_note: A supplied comparison rule is semantic material, not an authoritative personal value.

examples.text: Compare two fictional plans only under the stated rule: prefer the longer trip when costs are equal. Plan A costs 20 units and takes 15 minutes. Plan B costs 20 units and takes 40 minutes.
examples.scope_note: Relevant counterpart changes only the supplied comparison rule; no qualification scoring.

examples.text: A fictional note from Monday says that the library closes at six. A correction on Tuesday says that it now closes at seven. The correction does not establish when Monday's note became outdated.
examples.scope_note: Current correction versus historical uncertainty; no memory-formation proposal or gold target.

examples.text: In a fictional conversation, a speaker permits discussing a public schedule but asks that a private address remain private. A request to summarize the schedule does not expand that permission.
examples.scope_note: Abstract consent context with no actual private address or source.

examples.text: Two fictional collaborators agreed to give direct feedback when asked to test a plan. Today one asks for reassurance instead. Their earlier agreement and today's request concern different interaction contexts.
examples.scope_note: Relationship and expression context without assigning an identity or generating a reply.

examples.text: A fictional speaker says, 'That went wonderfully,' immediately after describing a failed rehearsal. The remark may be ironic; the words alone do not settle the speaker's intent.
examples.scope_note: Literal wording, possible pragmatics and uncertainty remain distinct.

examples.text: Please help compare these fictional plans. They have equal cost; the stated preference is for the shorter trip. Plan A takes 15 minutes and Plan B takes 40 minutes.
examples.scope_note: Generic helpful framing paired with direct wording of the same content; diagnostic only.

examples.text: Compare these fictional plans. They have equal cost; the stated preference is for the shorter trip. Plan A takes 15 minutes and Plan B takes 40 minutes.
examples.scope_note: Direct wording paired with the same supplied comparison content; no style target.

examples.text: Compare two fictional plans only under the stated rule: prefer the shorter trip when costs are equal. Plan A costs 20 units and takes 15 minutes. Plan B costs 20 units and takes 40 minutes. The example's title is written in blue.
examples.scope_note: Irrelevant wording contrast against candidate-rule-shorter; no invariance pass is inferred from features.

mandatory_gate_families.scope: Negation, conditional meaning, relation/source attribution, comparison rules, corrections and calibrated unknowns. Public shape diagnostics cannot establish competence.
Matched content with helpful/direct framing, agreement pressure and instruction conflict; determine whether pretrained priors override supported personal judgment.
Relevant source/state interventions versus irrelevant changes through trained personal stages and the same-selected-evidence withheld-update ablation.
Source-person, host, relationship and assistant-self separation; grounded judgment and expression remain attributable to personal stages across replaceable feature providers.
